goal_coverage.summary: The report identifies onboarding and customer-status capabilities with actors, domain terms and evidence.
Validation, duplicate detection, KYC risk scoring and manual-review decisions are documented with examples.
REST, OpenAPI, SOAP/WSDL and Kafka interfaces are represented.
Request/response examples are included from OpenAPI/docs and inferred from DTOs where needed.
OpenAPI operations and SOAP envelope examples are included.
Business and technical flows include Mermaid sequence and flowchart definitions.
Domain entities, state changes, persistence side effects and external integrations are documented.
Architecture, quality/readiness observations and refactoring options are included.
All demo evidence references validate against file paths and lines.

analysis_coverage.summary: The demo fixture accounts for all 32 included files from the source inventory; files without behavioral claims are still marked as inspected so finalize can distinguish reviewed files from accidental omissions.
